programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Wade Randall comes to North Fork and mesmerizes children with big stories of his past gun battles with outlaws. Lucas suspects he is all talk and exposes the truth after Randall refuses to accept a shootout challenge.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: A land speculator named Willard Prescott contacts Lucas about buying his land as the railroad is fast approaching the area. He bribes Lucas and when he refuses, Prescott makes it clear he will stop at nothing to get his land, one way or the other.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: After one of Mark's friends dies due to a shooting accident, he is totally against his father having a rifle. Lucas explains in vain the need for a rifle on the frontier, leading to Mark running away. Meanwhile, Lou has problems with a wanted outlaw.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: North Fork's blacksmith, Nils Swenson, volunteers to fill in for Marshal Micah Torrance while he is out of town. To keep the peace, Nils starts a policy that everyone turns in their gun upon entry to the town. His plan backfires when outlaws arrive.

programme.title: The Cowboy Way
programme.desc: Bubba, Booger and Cody take an important step toward becoming big-time cattle brokers! The guys are roping and doctoring yearlings on the Texas range. But when Booger's most reliable horse Studly trips, smashing both horse and rider to the ground, Booger must rush out to find a vet and tend to his injured horse. Just as the cowboys are about to leave Texas, a local rancher makes them an offer they can't refuse. Will the guys gamble on a cattle deal, taking on a herd before they have a buyer lined up? Back home in Alabama, Kaley's patience reaches a breaking point as houseguest Andrew tracks in mud and expects a free lunch. To top it off, he then asks if his whole family can crash there while he searches for a permanent residence. Misty finds some extra help with her troublesome barrel-racing horse. Booger and Matthew are on the hunt for the perfect one-year anniversary gift for Jaclyn. But Booger may have a special surprise up his sleeve.

programme.title: The Cowboy Way
programme.desc: A storm is coming to The Cowboy Way! Cody visits his cousin Bo to secure steer for his upcoming rodeo, leaving Booger and Bubba to ear-tag some yearlings by themselves. Bubba takes the opportunity to put houseguest Andrew to work. Misty continues to try and shake off her barrel-racing rust, and comes to a serious crossroads with her misbehaving mare. Jaclyn presses Booger to put a timeline on finding them a permanent home. Bubba sets out on a solo trip back to Texas to check out a lead on a big herd of Tigerstripe cattle. But just when he's about to cross the state line, a devastating category 4 hurricane barrels down on Alabama. All the cowboys' best-laid plans come to a screeching halt. Bubba must decide whether to turn around and head home, or push through for the big deal. Finding themselves directly in the path of the hurricane, everyone scrambles to prepare their ranches for the worst. Can the cowboys and their families safely ride out the storm?

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: An escaped killer wants to prove he hasn't lost his nerve when he holds up North Fork's General Store and takes Marshal Micah Torrance hostage. He provokes the town to try to face him, but only Lucas is strong enough to rise up to his challenge.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Mark finally captures a hawk that he has been chasing but he encounters a rattlesnake in the process. When a stranger quickly comes to his rescue, a grateful Mark invites the man to the ranch, unaware he is a fugitive on the run from the law.

programme.title: The Legend of 5 Mile Cave
programme.desc: A boy enchanted with tales from the Old West unlocks a mystery that could save their family farm. While his widowed mother struggles to avoid foreclosure, a mysterious stranger arrives looking for a room to rent. A bond with the boy grows as the drifter recounts breathtaking stories of Shooter Green, a legendary gunslinger accused of Arizona's biggest gold robbery. The truth is revealed, along with the secret of the drifter's past when a crooked lawman appears, hot on the trail of the stolen gold. Past and present collide in this tale of action, adventure and drama. Stars Adam Baldwin (The Last Ship, Full Metal Jacket, The Patriot), Jeremy Sumpter (Peter Pan, Soul Surfer), Jill Wagner (Braven, Christmas Cookies), and Jet Jurgensmeyer (Last Man Standing, American Sniper).

programme.title: The Cowboy Way
programme.desc: Cody's rodeo is fast approaching and time is running out, so the cowboys head out to scout talent for the team-roping event. Misty's new barrel-racing horse has taken her training to a whole new level. So when Booger starts teasing her, she challenges him to a one-on-one race: cowboy vs barrel racer! Misty also comes up with a potential rodeo venue, so Cody heads out to Bay Minette, AL to lock down a site. Bubba and Kaley prepare for houseguest Andrew's family to arrive. Will Andrew finally find his own place, and get out of Kaley's hair? Meanwhile, the guys' reputation as cattle brokers starts to flourish. Booger gets a lead on a healthy herd of cattle in Texas, and the guys consider if they should go all-in and buy the entire herd. Booger heads back to the Lone Star State and strikes a deal that seems to be a win-win. But just as the guys get the ball rolling with another big deal, a phone call from their buyer puts everything in jeopardy.

programme.title: The Cowboy Way
programme.desc: The cowboys step a little outside of their comfort zones. Looking to offload their new herd, the guys head down to the local stockyard to hone their bartering skills. Cody bounces a crazy rodeo idea off the boys - then uses them guinea pigs. Bubba plans a short getaway with Kaley, but there's a big catch: Booger's been tapped as the babysitter, with Jaclyn lending a helping hand. Kaley wonders if Booger is up to the challenge. His first attempts to feed and dress little Andie suggest he most certainly is not! While Bubba and Kaley aren't sure they'll return home to find everything in one piece, they do get some great news from houseguest Andrew. Cody is desperate to find the final missing piece for his rodeo: an announcer. While Booger adamant that he's the perfect man for the job, Cody has to resort to using reverse psychology on his old friend to avoid disaster.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: A troubled 18-year-old named Johnny Clover ransacks the North Fork Schoolhouse, stealing art supplies. Lucas later tries to help Johnny, but he lives with a controlling uncle who proves to be difficult to deal with.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: A neighboring rancher's son is seriously injured in an accident. With the young man's condition getting worse, Lucas learns the rancher won't take his son to the doctor since he feels his wife died from poor treatment.

programme.title: F Troop
programme.desc: A ten-year-old runaway named Joey Walker shows up at Fort Courage determined to enlist with the F Troop. O'Rourke tries to discourage the young boy by showing him that life there isn't glamorous. Meanwhile, tensions rise when Joey's mother arrives.

programme.title: F Troop
programme.sub-title: What Are You Doing After the Massacre?
programme.desc: A 147-year-old Hekawi Indian chief named Flaming Arrow attempts to win back the land from the United States Government starting with Fort Courage. He begins his attack by taking over the fort and trying to starve the F Troop until they surrender.

programme.title: Wild West Chronicles
programme.sub-title: Charles M. Russell: The Cowboy Artist
programme.desc: Charlie Russell is an aimless cowhand who loves the freedom of the cowboy way of life, and he is a self-taught artist who enjoys capturing the scenes of his rugged work on the range. Too embarrassed to ask people to pay for his paintings, he gives most of them away to friends or trades them for drinks at the saloon. But that changes quickly after he falls in love. Charlie's new bride Nancy gives him the encouragement he needs to stop cowboying in order to focus on his artwork. Under her watchful eye, he sobers up, stops cowboying, and improves his mastery of painting. Nancy is so proud of Charlie's talent that she doesn't hesitate to ask top dollar for his paintings. Years later, when legendary gunfighter-turned-newspaperman Bat Masterson tries to do a piece on Charlie, he quickly realizes that he must first deal with the woman behind the famous cowboy artist Charles M. Russell.

programme.title: Wild West Chronicles
programme.desc: When Black cowboy Nat Love overnights in Deadwood during a cattle drive, he decides to enter a Fourth of July cowboy competition. Confident in his roping, riding, and shooting skills, he is eager to test his mettle against the best cowboys around.

programme.title: Into The Wild Frontier
programme.desc: Although from humble beginnings, Tom Fitzpatrick is ambitious and intelligent. When he joins up with William Ashley's trapping expedition, he proves himself to be an invaluable member of the company, both as a hardy frontiersman and a shrewd businessman. Along with legendary mountain man Jedediah Smith, Fitzpatrick rediscovers the South Pass through the Rocky Mountains, opening the pathway that will enable western expansion for decades to come. Fitzpatrick quickly rises to the top of the fur trade and eventually takes over the company he once worked for, but he nearly loses everything when he takes a wrong turn while leading a supply train. Alone in the wilderness, he finds himself in a deadly game of cat-and-mouse with a band of Gros Ventre warriors. Somehow, Fitzpatrick must survive the harrowing trek back to safety without a horse, gun, or supplies.

programme.title: The Young Riders
programme.desc: After the destruction of a Pony Express station in Rock Creek, Teaspoon, The Kid, and Jimmy receive an assignment to rebuild it. They must relocate and learn the new territory near town as well as the neighbors in the area.

programme.title: Blown Away
programme.desc: When an explosion jolts Boston, bomb squad expert Jimmy Dove (Jeff Bridges) is thrust into the most harrowing work of his career. And when evidence points to his former mentor (Tommy Lee Jones), Dove must face a bitter enemy and a haunting past.

programme.title: The Mod Squad
programme.desc: Julie (Claire Danes), Pete (Giovanni Ribisi) and Linc (Omar Epps) are three problem teens headed to jail...until Captain Greer (Dennis Farina) offers them a deal to work for him and go undercover in the hip L.A. club scene. programme.desc: When a cancer-ridden doctor (Robert Hayes) is given a full-body transplant, he soon develops disturbing visions of a life he never led, of loves he's never experienced... and of a shocking, brutal murder. Wendel Meldrum and Thomas Cavanaugh also star.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A brilliant inventor (Ralph Waite) who murdered a man who stole credit for his work, is double crossed by the other inmates in jail when they discover his "small friends" -- microscopic machines --can seve just about any purposeï¿½including jailbreak.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: The Grell had come to earth not as equals, but as slaves. Now, an uprising has gripped the world in fear, and a high-ranking government official (Ted Shackelford), who is lost in Grell territory, experiences firsthand the ugly face of racism.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Dr. Eberhardt (Ralph Macchio) discovers a way for comatose patients to communicate with each other by interfacing with a computer. But when he hooks himself up to the machine, he discovers a cyberspace "paradise" he may never be able to leave!

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Cliff Robertson -- who starred in the very first episode of the classic series -- returns to the Outer Limits as an aging astronaut whose 1963 mission was a career-ending disaster. If he can just get back to space, perhaps he can clear his name.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Like other Star Fleet vessels, Ship (voice of Malcolm McDowell) has evolved and now controls the only human (Jack Noseworthy) aboard. But the relationship takes a dramatic turn when Man meets Woman and fights machine in a desperate bid for freedom!

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Do our memories define our identity? If we are merely the sum of our experiences, what do we become if those experiences are lost? Hope Wilson (Robbie Chong) faces this question when she meets a man who has purposely erased his own memories.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Courtesy of a freak accident (and The Outer Limits), an agoraphobe (Jane Adams) begins to hear the private thoughts of all of the tenants in her building...the good, the bad and the steamy. And it seems at least one of them may want to kill her.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A scientist -- who is also a religious zealot (David Ogden Stiers) -- secretly implants an embryo created with DNA from the Shroud of Turin into a young woman (Samantha Mathis) in order to scientifically engineer the Second Coming of Christ.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: The Outer Limits come to Victorian Whitechapel when a London doctor (Cary Elwes) races to capture the alien creature responsible for the Jack the Ripper murders. But when the alien frames the good doctor for the murders, his time may be up.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: The son (Saul Rubinek) of a concentration camp survivor (Peter Boretski) gets some unique help in proving the guilt of a former Nazi (Jan Rubes) living in the U.S....courtesy of a time traveler (Alex Daikun) and, of course, The Outer Limits.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: The planets Earth and Dregocia struggle to re-establish a fragile trust after a summit goes tragically wrong. Can a diplomat (Marcia Cross) calm the hawkish nature of both species…and can she overcome her own prejudices to save both worlds?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A meek anthropologist (Leland Orser) develops a serum for genetic dominance and tests it on himself. Now his newfound confidence takes complete control of him, turning him into an irrational, overly aggressive troglodyte! Can he reverse the process?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: The Haven is a high-tech apartment building which is run by supercomputer and almost completely eliminates the need for human contact. But when things begin to go wrong, neighbors who have never met must learn to work together in order to survive!

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When a scientist's (Kevin Nealon) experiment unintentionally creates a rift in the space-time continuum, he suddenly find himself caught in a time loop and soon begins to suspects sabotage. Terri Hawkes, Jennifer Copping and Ronny Cox also star.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A boy (Adam Hann-Byrd) , picked on by high-school bullies and neglected by his own father (Daniel Hugh Kelley), finds comfort in an alien (Chris Potter) who has crash-landed on earth. But is the alien what he claims to be? Never…in The Outer Limits.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: In a world dominated by alien invaders, a cynical American cafe owner (Nathan Fillion) must decide if he will risk his life to help an old lover fight for Earth or if he is happy not rocking the political boat. Derek de Lint also stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When Detective Terry Russo (Megan Gallagher) is called to investigate a double murder, she discovers she may be solving not one crime, but possibly hundreds. And that the culprit -- or culprits -- may not be human at all. Michael Riley also stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A convicted murderer is turned loose only to be hunted by the sister of his victim as part the hottest show on television, Judgment Day, which allows the family members -- and the at home audience -- to act as judge, jury and executioner!

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: An ex-con who had been serving time for spousal abuse is bent on revenge against his wife. He purchases a strange handgun from a gun dealer and finds this is no ordinary weapon and, in fact, he becomes quite attached to it…literally.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A device that allows people to change their appearance helps a nerdy guy become the mirror image of his hunky co-worker.. Now arrogant with his new-found good looks, the former nerd experiences a life like never before…and now he wants to keep it.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: An invisible alien race that inhabits the energy systems of a deserted spaceship envelopes the crew of a salvage team, responding to the empty vessel's distress signal, in a web of paranoia, suspicion and murder. Michael Shanks stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When a scientist uses his time machine to travel into the future, he discovers his wife lying dead in a pool of blood and a man fleeing the scene. Determined save her, he uses the time machine to go back in time...but is her death inevitable?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A blind man (Mackenzie Astin) regains his sight only to be used by the government for his unique ability to see an alien from another dimension who has been trapped on Earth and yearns to return home. But the government has other plans for her.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A veterinarian (Jessica Tuck) in a small farming community becomes alarmed when a genetically-engineered corn seed, intended to produce faster, larger yields of corn, produces something far more alarming …human mutations! Len Cariou also stars.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Steve, 53, says in the past 29 months, he has sent more than $100,000 to “Kelly,” his overseas “wife” whom he met on a dating website in 2012. Steve says “Kelly” is an American woman stuck in Nigeria trying to secure a $25 million fortune left to her by her parents. He admits she is also one of several clients who say they have large inheritances pending that he is trying to help -- deals Steve believes will make him millions. Despite never meeting “Kelly” in person and only talking to her on the phone a few times, Steve insists they are a “match made in heaven” -- which is why he sent her money for a marriage certificate. But Steve’s sister, Tammy, and niece, Kidist, say they believe he is being scammed, and they want him to cut ties with “Kelly” -- and his other so-called clients. Dr. Phil digs deep in search of answers. Is “Kelly” really the woman of Steve’s dreams, or is he being conned by a catfish? And, Steve has spent more than $135,000 so far on all of his clients -- is he ready to call it quits?

College girls and recent graduates who are struggling with mounting debt and a weak job market are turning to websites, such as SeekingArrangement.com, that introduce them to wealthy men who, in exchange for companionship - and maybe sex - help them pay their bills. Is this the Internet version of the world's oldest profession, or just a niche dating site? Four self-proclaimed sugar babies: Kristen, 21, Jennifer, 28, Janelle, 30, and Tracy, 31, passionately defend why their relationships differ from prostitution. Are their arranged monthly allowances and extravagant gifts the equivalent of being taken to fancy restaurants by a boyfriend or financially supported by a husband? Meet the creator of the website, Brandon, and hear why he says there's nothing wrong with these "mutually beneficial relationships." Former prosecutor and CNN analyst Sunny Hostin has some legal words of warning for Brandon and the ladies. Plus, an outraged father confronts Brandon in defense of his daughter, who he recently learned is on the site, and see why a self-proclaimed proud sugar daddy makes a hasty exit before meeting Dr. Phil!

programme.desc: A British intelligence officer turns into a whistleblower after learning about NSA espionage plans designed to ensure passage of a resolution of war against Iraq by the U.N. Security Council in 2003.

programme.title: Angel and Demon
programme.desc: When sheltered college student Angel, the daughter of the police chief, falls for Romelle “Demon” Montez, the ruthless leader of the South Side Mobb, they instantly become star-crossed lovers. Their toxic romance spirals into a world of gang violence and threatens Angel’s once promising future.

programme.title: Street Dreams: Los Angeles
programme.desc: After a traumatic event that takes the life of a young Elijah Wilkins' childhood friend, Elijah meets an FBI agent that sets him on the right path. He vows to indirectly avenge his friend's death by becoming an undercover cop for the LAPD with hopes of working his way into the counterintelligence division of the FBI. When he stumbles upon a case involving domestic terrorism, Elijah sees this case as the perfect opportunity that could possibly usher him in the FBI, but not without risking it all.

programme.title: Swept
programme.desc: Five old friends receive invitations to their 20 – year high school reunion, hoping to connect and reminisce. Little do they know, they’ve all been keeping a secret about events that unfolded over twenty years ago. Will secrets stay buried? Or with the weight of their guilt finally tear them apart?

programme.title: Melted Lipstick
programme.desc: Riley Davis, a young woman in her twenties, who navigates through life fraught with insecurities about her body, self-esteem issues. Her life takes a mystical turn when she encounters an enigmatic voodoo doctor who gifts her a special lipstick, claiming that it holds the power to transform her into anyone she desires when applied. However, Riley soon learn that all magic comes for a price, as she goes down a dangerous and deadly path of destruction.

programme.title: The Games We Play
programme.desc: Married and settled, Beejay and Montez, are so busy that they have not been intimate in months. When Beejay confesses this detail to her girlfriends, they convince her that all men cheat, and that they can prove it.

programme.title: Kiss Me Once

programme.title: The Jealous Son

Meanwhile, a crooked cop is under suspicion for murder, and connections are made between him and Jay. Torn between duty and loyalty, Detective Johnson is caught in the middle. As the prosecution struggles, Jay and his business partners work to exist the dangerous world cleanly.

programme.title: Unsealed: Alien Files
programme.desc: In April 2011 the FBI declassified decades' worth of secret government documents that contain thousands of reports of UFO sightings and alien activity. Each episode of this half-hour series tackles one alien case by investigating the previously off-limits government files. The program re-examines key evidence and follows developing leads based on newly released information. Mass UFO sightings, personal abductions, government cover-ups, and alien news from around the world are some of the topics covered by the show's panel of specialists, who include journalists, researchers, and radio and TV hosts. After watching an episode of "Unsealed: Alien Files," you may begin to believe that "we are not alone."

programme.title: Unsealed: America's Conspiracy Files
programme.desc: Some people think everything is a conspiracy. Luckily for them, the FBI declassified decades' worth of government documents in April 2011, allowing people to gain more insight behind some of the most popular conspiracy theories. After acquiring new information, the show's team of specialists re-examines faulty assumptions, looks for inconsistencies and explores new leads in an attempt to get to the bottom of each case. Just make sure you have your tin foil handy when watching the show.

programme.title: The Conspiracy Show
programme.desc: Many believe that there are things in this world that aren't made public that the average person isn't supposed to know about. Using interviews with top researchers, skeptics, independent thinkers and authors, Syrett is determined to uncover the truth to some of the most extraordinary claims of conspiracy.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: Four more will punch their tickets into the next round as GLORY & RISE search for the baddest featherweight on the planet in this year long tournament. On the GLORY side, top ranked German Polish fighter Denis Wosik (40-9-1, 9 KO) takes on Thai veteran Suarek (107-40-11, 39 KO) and Italy’s Achraf Aasila (53-13, 13 KO) meets France’s Lounis Saing (19-4-1, 12 KO). Meanwhile on the RISE side of the bracket, Japan’s Yutaro Asahi (17-9, 4 KO) clashes with Spain’s Eduardo Catalin (17-3-1) and top Japanese prospect Yura Kono (15-1, 7 KO) goes up against China’s Dexiang Kong (35-10). In addition to the Last Featherweight Standing matchups, Shiro Matsumoto (53-17-4, 18 KO) defends his RISE bantamweight title against top challenger Masahi Kumura (24-7, 12 KO) and Australian KO artists Chadd Collins (64-18-2, 32) defends his RISE super lightweight championship against the great Kento Haraguchi (25-4-1, 14 KO).

Among the other names taking part in Phase Two are Nabil Khachab (29-6-1, 4 KO), Iancu Ionut (31-11, 13 KO), Rade Opacic (21-7, 16 KO), Milos Cvjeticanin (13-4, 9 KO), Sofian Laidouni (39-5-1, 20 KO), and many more. In addition, Chico Kwasi (44-5-2, 23 KO) will defend his GLORY welterweight world title against Mehdi Ait El Hadj (35-4-2, 8 KO), Mory Kromah (34-3-1, 20 KO) returns and takes on Cristian Ristea (44-26, 13 KO) in a heavyweight match-up outside the tournament, and Tayfun Ozcan (88-11-3, 28 KO) clashes with rival Don Sno (6-2, 3 KO).

programme.title: Peak Performance - Drew Benton
programme.desc: In the Marathon Peak Performance at the 2023 Lake Murray Bassmaster Elite Series, watch Drew Benton's tournament as he notched his 2nd Bassmaster victory. Benton started the week in 2nd place, jumped into the lead, fell to 10th and then completed a comeback of over 5 pounds on the Final Day to win.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Ed Loughran III
programme.desc: Ed Loughran, who is also a practicing attorney, notched his biggest fishing achievement by winning the Bassmaster Elite Series event at Lake Champlain. He leaned on both largemouth and smallmouth en route to his first career victory. He is the Marathon Peak Performance for the 8th event of the 2024 Elite Series season.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Joey Cifuentes
programme.desc: In the Marathon Peak Performance at the 7th stop of the 2023 Bassmaster Elite Series season, Joey Cifuentes takes the title at Lake St. Clair by going against the grain. Cowboy Cifuentes is a Rookie on the Elite Series but with two wins in 2023, he has wowed the fishing world.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Brock Mosley
programme.desc: In his 8-year Bassmaster Elite Series career, Brock Mosley has been so close to major titles but fallen just short with 5 2nd place finishes and even more Top 10’s. Watch Mosley put four great days together on his way to his first Elite Series title at the 2023 Folds of Honor Bassmaster Elite at the Sabine River and take home the Marathon Peak Performance!

programme.title: Peak Performance - Kyoya Fujitia
programme.desc: In the Marathon Peak Performance for the 8th stop of the 2023 Bassmaster Elite Series season, watch Kyoya Fujita take the title at Lake Champlain for the first B.A.S.S. win of his career. The young Japanese prodigy stormed to 5 Top 10's in his Rookie season.

programme.title: Peak Performance - John Garrett
programme.desc: The Marathon Peak Performance for the third stop of the Elite Series season features John Garrett and his impressive week at the Harris Chain of Lakes. The former College Champion and current Elite Series rookie led wire to wire and got his first blue trophy in just his 3rd event of the season.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Jay Przekurat
programme.desc: As a 23-year old rookie on the Bassmaster Elite Series, Jay Przekurat made history. In the Marathon Peak Performance at the St. Lawrence River, Przekurat becomes the youngest Elite Series champion and also breaks 100 pounds for the first time in history for a smallmouth bass event. Watch his week unfold in Clayton, NY.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Lee Livesay
programme.desc: Walk on the wild side with Lee Livesay and his entire week at Lake Fork as he looked to go back to back on his home lake. Livesay was the local favorite with the most amount of knowledge at Lake Fork, but sometimes that can bite you. In the Marathon Peak Performance of the Event, Livesay wins his third Elite Series title and fourth overall Bassmaster victory in just a span of 18 months.

programme.title: Peak Performance - CliffPrince
programme.desc: Watch Cliff Prince's winning week at Wheeler Lake in this edition of the Marathon Peak Performance of the tournament. Prince found a magical spot where the fishing was on fire the first two hours of every tournament day and it lasted all four days en route to his first blue trophy on the Bassmaster Elite Series. The area was 4 to 5 feet deep and Prince maintained a low profile and fished his chatterbait around grass and over a hard spot without using his forward facing sonar.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Brandon Palaniuk
programme.desc: In this Marathon Peak Performance, we take a look at Brandon Palaniuk's amazing 2022 season en route to his second Angler of the Year title.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Will Davis Jr.
programme.desc: In his Marathon Peak Performance of the week, watch Will Davis Jr. win his first Bassmaster Elite Series title in dramatic fashion on his home body of water. Davis won by just 2 ounces over Brandon Palaniuk, making it the closest margin of victory since Toledo Bend of 2011.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Bryant Schmitt
programme.desc: Bryan Schmitt is one of the winningest anglers in professional fishing and his great track record is noted on grassy river fisheries. Schmitt ended 2022 with a big victory on the Mighty Mississippi River in La Crosse, Wisconsin. Watch his stellar week in the Marathon Peak Performance of the tournament.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Austin Felix
programme.desc: Austin Felix had an impeccable smallmouth record in Bassmaster Elite Series events prior to Lake Oahe, but the Minnesota pro went to another level after four successful days in South Dakota. In the Marathon Peak Performance at Lake Oahe, watch Austin Felix take home his first tour-level victory with Bassmaster.

programme.title: Peak Performance -Patrick Walters
programme.desc: Through just 5 years on the Bassmaster Elite Series, Patrick Walters has an incredible resume. He added another accolade with a win at Lake Murray, doing so in impressive fashion. Congratulations to ‪@patrickwaltersfishing5121‬, he is the Marathon Peak Performance at the 5th stop of the 2024 season.

programme.title: The Cast
programme.desc: Ray Scott had no plan other than a hypothetical idea of launching a legitimate pro bass fishing tour. Through his uncanny salesmanship the 1967 All-American was a success leading to the formation of the Bass Anglers Sportsman Society (B.A.S.S.).

programme.title: The Cast
programme.desc: By the 1980s B.A.S.S. was gaining national media notoriety while membership swelled to nearly 500 000. The Bassmasters TV series debuted in 1984 to capture the drama as it unfolded on the water. The show followed the Bassmaster Tournament Trail.

programme.title: The Cast
programme.desc: B.A.S.S. in the 90s was best described as explosive and exciting. A legend won his fourth Bassmaster Classic while another hero retired. Another became the first B.A.S.S. millionaire.

programme.title: The Cast
programme.desc: Bill Dance a furniture salesman from Memphis Tenn. caught the first bass in Scott’s 1967 All-American tournament a harbinger of great things to come. Dance went on to become the sport’s first superstar fueled by his outgoing charisma.

programme.title: The Cast
programme.desc: Roland Martin early on established himself as a B.A.S.S. superstar by winning 19 tournaments. Jimmy Houston’s recognizable giggle mop of blonde hair and wide-framed sunglasses made him an instant hit.

programme.title: The Cast
programme.desc: Hank Parker who won the Classic in 1979 and 1989 also won 1983 B.A.S.S. Angler of the Year. In 14 years as a B.A.S.S. pro Parker qualified for 14 Classics before retiring at the age of 37 going on to be successful with his Hank Parker Outdoor Magazine.

programme.title: The Cast
programme.desc: Voted by fans as the greatest professional bass angler of all time Rick Clunn won four Bassmaster Classics two of them in consecutive years and went on to compete in an unprecedented 32 Classics.

programme.title: The Cast
programme.desc: Watch the story of a river and how it inspired three innovators and dedicated bass fishermen to invent and build an industry and culture that meant everything to them. Those men are Johnny Morris Forrest Wood and Jerry McKinnis.

programme.title: The Cast
programme.desc: Watch the inside story of Rick Clunn’s 50-year B.A.S.S. career leading up to his 500th event.

programme.title: The Cast
programme.desc: Watch the inside story of superstar Denny Brauer’s incredible career spanning three decades with a Bassmaster Classic win Bassmaster Angler of the Year title 17 wins and in incredible impact on the sport of bass fishing.

programme.title: The Cast
programme.desc: Bryan Kerchal is the only amateur angler to win the Bassmaster Classic. See the heartwarming story of his career on The Cast presented by Bass Pro Shops.

programme.desc: By the 1980s B.A.S.S. was gaining national media notoriety while membership swelled to nearly 500 000. The Bassmasters TV series debuted in 1984 to capture the drama as it unfolded on the water. The show followed the Bassmaster Tournament Trail.

programme.title: The Cast
programme.desc: B.A.S.S. in the 90s was best described as explosive and exciting. A legend won his fourth Bassmaster Classic while another hero retired. Another became the first B.A.S.S. millionaire.

programme.title: The Cast
programme.desc: Bill Dance a furniture salesman from Memphis Tenn. caught the first bass in Scott’s 1967 All-American tournament a harbinger of great things to come. Dance went on to become the sport’s first superstar fueled by his outgoing charisma.

programme.title: The Cast
programme.desc: Roland Martin early on established himself as a B.A.S.S. superstar by winning 19 tournaments. Jimmy Houston’s recognizable giggle mop of blonde hair and wide-framed sunglasses made him an instant hit.

programme.desc: Ramaiya Vastavaiya is a romantic drama directed by Prabhu Deva. When he proposes marriage, her protective brother (Sonu Sood) challenges him to prove that he can live and work like a farmer before earning her hand. Set in vibrant rural India, the film blends romance, comedy, and family drama with catchy music and traditional values.

programme.title: Best of Morning Footy
programme.desc: CBS SPORTS GOLAZO NETWORK is a first-of-its-kind free, 24-hour channel in the U.S.dedicated exclusively to global soccer coverage. CBS SPORTS GOLAZO NETWORK, with its unparalleled coverage of all the top domestic and international soccer competitions across the globe, is the ultimate year-round streaming destination for soccer fans. CBS SPORTS GOLAZO NETWORK is anchored weekdays from 7:00-9:00 AM, ET, by - MORNING FOOTY, the Network’s flagship morning show. Every weekday, MORNING FOOTY host Susannah Collins along with former U.S. Men’s National Team player Charlie Davies, analyst Nico Cantor and comedian Alexis Guerreros bring their unique voices and fresh perspectives to the latest news and storylines impacting soccer worldwide. As soccer’s new staple show for fans everywhere, MORNING FOOTY delivers a daily dose of razor-sharp insights and laughs with match highlights, compelling analysis, entertaining interviews, updates - from reporter Jenny Chiu and more that is sure to help kick off your day. In addition, the Network will feature live matches, pre- and post-match breakdowns, magazine shows, films from Paramount+’s STORIES FROM THE BEAUTIFUL GAME soccer documentary collection and original programming. The Network’s live matches and re-airs utilize CBS Sports’ collection of top-tier soccer properties, including UEFA club competitions, Serie A, NWSL, Concacaf national team competitions, Barclays Women’s Super League, Campeonato Brasileirão Série A, Scottish Professional Football League, Argentina Liga Profesional de Fútbol and the AFC Champions League, among others. Watch CBS SPORTS GOLAZO NETWORK 24 hours a day, 7 days a week and all 365 days a year.

programme.title: Bells Beach
programme.sub-title: ENCORE: 2018 Rip Curl Pro Bells Beach | Finals Day
programme.desc: Today, Stephanie Gilmore and Italo Ferreira won the Rip Curl Pro Bells Beach, Stop No. 2 of the World Tour. After an exciting week of competitive drama, upsets and emotion, the final day of competition ran in 4-to-6ft conditions at the world renowned Bells Beach… 2018 marks the Rip Curl Pro Bells Beach’s 57th year around the sun, as well as 3x World Champion Mick Fanning's final event on the World Tour.

programme.title: Lawn Patrol
programme.desc: The WSL takes you inside the digs of the world's top surfers.

programme.title: Kelly Slater: The Lost Tapes
programme.sub-title: Kelly Slater: Lost Tapes | A New Year - Episode 1
programme.desc: In the premiere episode, presented by Outerknown, Kelly Slater prepares for the start of the 2019 WSL Championship Tour and the hunt for his twelfth World Title. Before the demanding season begins, he trains his body and fuels his mindset with the people and passions that make the Gold Coast of Australia feel like home.

programme.title: Kelly Slater: The Lost Tapes
programme.sub-title: Kelly Slater: Lost Tapes | The Storm - Episode 2
programme.desc: In episode 2, presented by Outerknown, Kelly Slater heads to the next event at Bells Beach early to refocus after a disappointing start. In the iconic surf town of Torquay, Australia, he connects with the rich surf scene and inspires the young local surfers. With one of the biggest swells in memory headed towards Bells, he surfs as much as possible and dials in his quiver before the crucial event.

programme.title: WSL Inside Pro Surfing
programme.sub-title: Inside Pro Surfing - Lexus WSL Finals Fiji presented by Corona Cero 2025
programme.desc: After nine regular season events, the Lexus WSL Finals brings the top 5 men and top 5 women in professional surfing to Lower Trestles for a one-day, winner-take-all, showdown for the coveted title of World Champion. From Pipeline and Portugal to Teahupo'o and Cloudbreak, it has been a hard fought season for the world's best surfers. Ten surfers enter, and only two will emerge as Champions and add their name to the legacy of the sport.

programme.title: WSL Replay
programme.sub-title: REPLAY | All the Action from the MEO Rip Curl Pro Portugal presented by Corona Cero 2025
programme.desc: The MEO Rip Curl Pro Portugal presented by Corona Cero Replay showcases elite surfing at Supertubos, one of Europe's premier beach-breaks known for its powerful, hollow waves and consistent barrels. As the third stop on the 2025 World Surf League Championship Tour, this event is crucial for competitors looking to build momentum in their World Title campaigns.

programme.title: All In: Life on the WSL Championship Tour
programme.sub-title: All In | A Last Chance For Surfing Glory At Pipeline And Honolua Bay
programme.desc: The European leg of the WSL World Tour season is finished and Kanoa Igarashi and Steph Gilmore are off to Hawaii, where a year's worth of surfing their hearts out will culminate at two of the best waves in the world: Maui's Honolua Bay and Oahu's Pipeline. See how Kanoa and Steph handle the mounting pressure in this episode of All In: Life on the WSL Championship Tour.

programme.title: WSL Competition Highlights
programme.desc: See all the best scores from the WSL surfing season.

programme.title: WSL Replay
programme.sub-title: REPLAY | All the Action from the MEO Rip Curl Pro Portugal presented by Corona Cero 2025
programme.desc: The MEO Rip Curl Pro Portugal presented by Corona Cero Replay showcases elite surfing at Supertubos, one of Europe's premier beach-breaks known for its powerful, hollow waves and consistent barrels. As the third stop on the 2025 World Surf League Championship Tour, this event is crucial for competitors looking to build momentum in their World Title campaigns.

programme.title: All In: Life on the WSL Championship Tour
programme.sub-title: Can Julian Wilson Keep His Winning Momentum Going in Portugal? | All In Ep5
programme.desc: While Julian Wilson and Jordy Smith head to Portugal for the MEO Rip Curl Pro Peniche, Carissa Moore and Lakey Peterson travel home to relax for a month before having to compete in the final event on the women's WSL World Tour season, the Beachwaver Maui Pro. After his win in France, Julian needs a good result in Portugal to have a chance at the men's world title. For Jordy, Portugal is a chance to let loose and charge. For every surfer, this is the most critical point in the world tour season, as the Hawaiian leg looms on the horizon.

programme.title: WSL Competition Highlights

programme.title: #TOURNOTES
programme.desc: Take an inside look at the day-to-day of the World Surf League tour.

programme.title: Brilliant Corners
programme.sub-title: Wolves' Weddings | Brilliant Corners: Algeria, Episode 2
programme.desc: Sam, Lucy, and Erwan head to the naturally beautiful Kabyle region along with locals Dihya Nasri and Walid Assef. Once there, they surf some clean, cold, and completely uncrowded peelers and get some famous ice cream in Béjaïa, a market city known for its rich music scene, vibrant clothing, and incredible views of the Sapphire Coast. They then explore the stunning Cap Carbon headlands and learn about the native Berber culture and ancient Kabyle language.

programme.title: WSL Inside Pro Surfing
programme.sub-title: Inside Pro Surfing: Lexus US Open of Surfing presented by Pacifico 2025
programme.desc: "It's summer's biggest surf stage." The Lexus US Open of Surfing presented by Pacifico is where the next generation earns their spotlight and where future World Champions are forged. Every heat in Huntington counts. With thousands packing the sand and more looking on from the iconic Huntington Beach pier, it's one of the most electric vibes on the Challenger Series and World Longboard Tours, and the energy jumps off the screen. Watching live = the next best thing to being there.

programme.title: The Vault
programme.desc: 2003 was an epic year for the FIJI PRO. Andy Irons took down Cory Lopez in an epic battle to win the event. Andy was ripping the entire contest and put the world on watch that he was coming for his second world title. - Andy and Cory: It happens a lot on tour, friends who travel and stay together end up in the same heat surfing against each other. Sometimes ‘friendship' stays on the beach and other times they go out and see who can get the best waves and have a fun surf. Andy got on a roll on the Final day of the contest, throwing down 9's and 10's through the Quarter, Semi and Final. He had a perfect 10 and backup 9 point rides before good mate Cory had even put a score on the board. There were three perfect 10 point scores handed out during this Quiksilver Pro Fiji and Andy scored them all. It was Andy at his best in a year when he won 5 out of the 12 CT events and a second World Title.

programme.title: Brilliant Corners
programme.sub-title: Casbah Coast | Brilliant Corners: Algeria, Episode 1
programme.desc: Host and Longboard Champion Sam Bleakley travels to Algeria with Australian longboarder and writer Lucy Small, French surfer and adventurer Erwan Simon, and local Dihya Nasri, the only female surfer in all of Algeria. They continue to explore the over 1,000 miles of mostly unsurfed Mediterranean coastline, paddling out at a slabbing wave near the capital city of Algiers. Sam Bleakley, Lucy Small, Erwan Simon, and Dihya Nasri have a dawn patrol session at a nearby break and meet some of the local surfers in the tight-knit community as they continue to explore Algeria, one of the Brilliant Corners of the earth.

programme.title: Kelly Slater: The Lost Tapes
programme.sub-title: Kelly Slater: Lost Tapes | The Dream Tour - Episode 3
programme.desc: In Bali, Kelly is dealt a blow when he gets tough news regarding his longtime friend and competitor Sunny Garcia. When competition begins, he channels Sunny's power and focus as he advances through challenging heats and attempts to prove he can still perform at the peak of his powers.

programme.title: Kelly Slater: The Lost Tapes
programme.sub-title: Kelly Slater: Lost Tapes | Out of The Box
programme.desc: Before the next Championship Tour stop in Margaret River, Australia, Kelly takes some time to explore all the natural attractions that the stunning region has to offer. Then, after getting reacquainted with Western Australia’s powerful surf, he faces heavy competition and even heavier barrels at The Box.

programme.title: WSL Inside Pro Surfing
programme.sub-title: Inside Pro Surfing: Lexus Pipe Pro presented by YETI 2025
programme.desc: Welcome to the starting line. The champs are back, the rookies have arrived, and the entire surf universe turns its eyes to the place where it all begins: the North Shore of O`ahu. Reigning Pipe champs Barron Mamiya and Caity Simmers, rookies Erin Brooks and George Pittar, and the rest of the world’s best are ready to fire the Championship Tour back up. The 2025 Tour starts NOW.

programme.title: WSL Replay
programme.sub-title: REPLAY | All the Action from the Surf Abu Dhabi Pro 2025
programme.desc: The WSL Championship Tour makes its groundbreaking debut in the Middle East in this Replay of the 2025 Surf Abu Dhabi Pro Final Series. The second stop on the CT marks professional surfing's continued global expansion and also establishes Abu Dhabi as an official surf destination. Engineered for excellence, this high-performance wave provides a canvas for the world's best surfers, set against the stunning backdrop of the Arabian Gulf.

programme.title: Gold Coast
programme.sub-title: ENCORE: 2017 Quiksilver Pro Gold Coast | Finals Day
programme.desc: It was an emotional day full of twists and turns, not the least of which was Matt Wilkinson's return to the Final at Snapper for the second straight year. Florence, Medina, Slater and Parkinson made their intentions clear and all wrapped up solid results. Fanning, Smith and Andino will need to do better at the Margaret River event if they hope to stay in touch with the early leaders. The Title chase is officially on, and there are heaps of great stories and moments to look forward to as the Tour moves to West Oz.

programme.desc: The story follows three friends who discover they have the power to travel back and forth 20 years with a sneeze. However, the future is not as good as they hoped, and they need to take on the responsibility of saving the world.

programme.title: IP MAN: The Awakening [English Dub]
programme.desc: When a young Master Ip stops a kidnapping, he ignites a turf war with a ruthless human-trafficking ring. In retaliation, the gang kidnaps one of Ip Man's close friends, forcing him to face the group's brutal boxing champion head-on.

programme.title: MASTER Z: IP MAN LEGACY [English Dub]
programme.desc: Following his defeat by Master Ip, Cheung Tin Chi tries to make a life with his young son in Hong Kong, waiting tables at a bar that caters to expats. But it's not long before the mix of foreigners, money, and triad leaders draw him once again to the fight.

programme.title: First Love [English Dub]
programme.desc: One night in Tokyo, Leo, a young boxer, meets his first love, Monica, an imprisoned sex worker. Caught up in a drug-smuggling scheme, they find themselves pursued by a corrupt cop, a yakuza, his nemesis, and a female assassin.

programme.title: The Man From Nowhere [English Dub]
programme.desc: Ex-agent Tae-shik must confront his past when a gang kidnaps a girl he cares for, forcing him into a dangerous mission.

programme.title: Rampant [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Returning from imprisonment, a prince and his fellow countrymen band together to battle bloodthirsty demons.

programme.title: Sinkhole [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: After finally realizing his dream of owning a house in Seoul, Dong-won held housewarming parties and invited some of his co-workers. But his happiness is short-lived as the entire building falls to the ground. Dongwon, his co-workers Kim and Eun-joo, and a nosy neighbor, Man-soo, must make it out of a 500-meter sinkhall.

programme.title: OK! MADAM [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Miyoung, the owner of a twisted donut shop, goes on a first-time trip to Hawaii with her husband Seokhwan. However, their plane is hijacked all of a sudden.

programme.title: Kill Zone 2 [English Dub]
programme.desc: A Hong Kong cop named Kit busts a major gangster only to find his cover blown and his main witness gone. The gangster, in retaliation, has him kidnapped and put in a Thai jail with a false criminal identity. Lowly prison guard Chai, with his extraordinary fighting skills, guards Kit and prevents his escape. The prison guard’s daughter suffers from a rare form of leukemia and Kit is the only donor who can save her. The prison guard discovers Kit’s real identity and helps him to escape in return for his agreeing to save his daughter. Together, Kit and Chai must face and take down the gangster and his minions.

programme.title: THE GREAT WAR OF ARCHIMEDES [English Dub]
programme.desc: It is the early 1930s and the command of the Japanese Imperial Navy determines to construct the world's biggest and most formidable battleship, Yamato. One of the admirals, Yamamoto Isoroku, disagrees. He recruits the upstart and mathematics' expert Tadashi Kai who discovers there are discrepancies between the official cost estimates and the actual figures. They soon find out that they have stumbled upon a conspiracy.

programme.title: Pushing Hands [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Having just moved from Beijing, elderly tai chi master Mr. Chu (Sihung Lung) struggles to adjust to life in New York, living with his Americanized son Alex (Ye-tong Wang). Chu immediately butts heads with his put-upon white daughter-in-law, Martha (Deb Snyder), a writer who seems to blame him for her own paralyzing inability to focus. But when Chu begins teaching tai chi at a local school, his desire to make a meaningful connection comes to fruition in the most unexpected of ways. PUSHING HANDS is the debut film from Oscar-winning director Ang Lee, forming the first chapter in his 'Father Knows Best' trilogy, which depicts the tensions between the traditional Confucian values of the older generation and the realities of modern life. Co-written by collaborator James Schamus, PUSHING HANDS was selected by the 1992 Berlin International Film Festival and won three Golden Horse Awards, paving the way for Lee's worldwide success with films such as CROUCHING TIGER, HIDDEN DRAGON and BROKEBACK MOUNTAIN. Presented in a new 2K restoration.

programme.title: Shadow [English Dub]
programme.desc: In a kingdom ruled by a young and unpredictable king, the military commander has a secret weapon: a shadow, a look-alike who can fool both his enemies and the King himself. programme.desc: Matt is out for revenge. Last year Dale beat him badly at the Annual Vintage bike race in Barber, Alabama. But this year there is a whole new tale to tell. With just days until the race - Dale is secretly struggling to get the bike he beat Matt with last year up and working. Matt struggles just to locate a 100-year old bike. Matt's prayers are answered thanks to an old Catholic Priest he located who has possession of a bike. The priest might let Matt have the bike to race - but there are conditions. The toughest one: Don't tell Dale you have it. Can Matt afford to buy the bike and get it running in time for the race without Dale seeing it? Will Dale even get his broken bike started? And if they ever get to race, will Matt exact his revenge?

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.desc: Built in the mid-60’s by eccentric engineer “Wild Bill” Gelbke, the Road Dog was, and still is, the largest motorcycle ever built. It utilized aircraft tubing, Corvette disc brakes, and a Chevy truck differential to keep it stable. The one-off creation disappeared when Gelbke did in 1978. Outflanked once when the bike was spotted and sold to a private collector in 1995, Dale has vowed to locate the machine and make Wheels Through Time its final resting place.

programme.title: What's In the Barn?

programme.title: What's In the Barn?

programme.title: What's In the Barn?

programme.desc: For Dale and Matt sometimes the dotted line to treasure splits and heads in opposite directions. In this edition of What’s in the Barn, time is thrust to the forefront of this multi-state, long distance, north, south search. Timeless and priceless 110 year old bikes, antique cars, airplanes, and the infamous Egberts 1930 neon Harley-Davidson sign that coined the phrase “Ride a Winner” are high on this father and son’s list of “must haves”. The clock ticks, both literally and figuratively, on one rare time piece and two old-timer’s cars, bikes, and automobiles.

programme.title: The Ed Sullivan Show
programme.desc: "The Ed Sullivan Show" is TV's longest-running variety show. It ran on Sunday nights for an amazing 23 years. The show's host, Ed Sullivan, had been a syndicated newspaper columnist who hosted two radio shows before agreeing to try television. On camera, Sullivan always seemed nervous and ill at ease; he couldn't sing or dance, but he knew people who could and signed them to appear each week. Called "Toast of the Town" until 1955, "The Ed Sullivan Show" featured the TV debuts of artists such as Irving Berlin, Hedy Lamarr, Walt Disney, and Fred Astaire and Jane Powell. The format of the show changed very little over the years, with Sullivan presenting acts that tried to please everyone. A typical show might include a few comics, an aria performed by an opera diva, an acrobat and maybe a plug for a new film from a well-known movie star.

But Fujiko learns of his antics and with the help of an underground organization called the Red Voyagers League, heads to the North Pole. Who will claim the prize of the Vatican Crown?

programme.title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 [English Subtitle]

programme.title: Sonic X
programme.desc: When Mr. Stewart drops by for a surprise visit, Chris and Chuck are barely able to keep Sonic and Friends' stay a secret and after Chris' uncle arrives, things get messier. Everyone, including Ella and Mr. Tanaka, are going to find out!

programme.title: Sonic X
programme.desc: After Eggman discovers that he is being watched by the military he sends E-90 to swallow the satellite, but this disrupts everyone's TVs! So, Chuck and Tails decide to upgrade the Tornado into X-Tornado, allowing Sonic to enter high altitude in order to destroy E-90.

programme.title: Sonic X
programme.desc: After Chris, Amy, Cream and Cheese arrive at a resort, Eggman appears and tries to take over with his E-39 but Sonic arrives and tries to stop him. However Sonic is unable to swim, and the robot tries to drag him into the ocean!

programme.title: Sonic X
programme.desc: It's Team Sonic vs Team Eggman in a game of baseball for a Chaos Emerald! Team Sonic falls behind at first but then wins with a Sonic super-play, only to have Eggman to cheat and try to steal the Emerald regardless!

programme.title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 [English Subtitle]
programme.sub-title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 -EP85 The ICPO’s Secret Order [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: ICPO Bureau Chief Jasmine is an able commissioner. She uses the governor to spur Zenigata into action, as she has a secret plan to arrest Lupin. But Jasmine's plan is to make this mission her very last at ICPO so she could get married. Who is Jasmine marrying? Will her plan to arrest Lupin succeed?

programme.title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 [English Subtitle]
programme.sub-title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 -EP86 The Mysterious Nocturnal Mask [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Nocturnal Mask murdered the Duke of Le Mond and stole his diamonds. ICPO is having trouble solving the case, so they induct mystery author Conan Drill as a special inspector. Drill deduces that the true identity of Nocturnal Mask is Lupin. Learning that Count Johannes is his next target, he and Zenigata lie in wait at the Johannes Mansion, where a costume ball is taking place ...

programme.title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 [English Subtitle]
programme.sub-title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 -EP87 When the Devil Calls to Lupin [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: In a night of thunder and rain, a man gives Lupin a doll. That very night Lupin has a nightmare of being manipulated by a man named Mephistopheles. What is going on?

programme.title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress [English Subtitle]
programme.sub-title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress E04 [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: At a time when the industrial revolution was carrying the world into the modern age, a horde of undead monsters suddenly appeared. They could not be killed unless their hearts, which were protected by a layer of iron, were pierced. Humans bitten by them would come back as undead monsters themselves. These undead, which would later be known as "Kabane," exploded in population until they finally overran the world. - - The people of Hinomoto, a nation in the far east, built fortresses known as "stations" throughout the land that have allowed them to survive the threat of the Kabane. People can only travel between these stations using fortified steam locomotives known as "Hayajiro," and they have managed to stay alive by sharing resources in this way. - - Ikoma is a young steamsmith living at Aragane Station, a city that specializes in the manufacture of iron and steam engines. He is working on developing a unique anti-Kabane weapon called a "piercing gun" as he waits for his chance to prove his strength. - - Then, one day, a Hayajiro called the "Iron Fortress" makes its way through the front lines to arrive at Aragane Station. When Ikoma begins his usual maintenance routine, he sees a mysterious girl who is exempt from her Kabane inspection. That night, Ikoma sees the girl again and learns that her name is Mumei, but then an out-of-control Hayajiro overrun by Kabane charges into Aragane Station. - - The Kabane pour out of the train into Aragane Station. Ikoma races against the flow of the panicked residents, this time determined not to run away, but to defeat the Kabane with his piercing gun!

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Rick Grimes, policía de una pequeña localidad de Georgia, despierta de un coma y repentinamente se encuentra en un mundo apocalíptico. Desorientado, en busca de su familia y una explicación a lo acontecido, Rick ha de adaptarse al nuevo orden.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Rick llega a caballo a Atlanta, donde encuentra una ciudad desolada. Tras escapar de una situación de peligro, Rick se une a un grupo de supervivientes en unos grandes almacenes, donde le espera un enemigo más peligroso que los zombis.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Rick regresa a Atlanta al sentirse culpable de haber dejado a Merle abandonado en un edificio asolado por zombis. En el campamento, la inesperada llegada de Rick causa tensión entre Lori y Shane, quien había asegurado que Rick había muerto.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: En Atlanta, una banda armada sorprende al grupo de Rick mientras están buscando a Merle. Entretanto, en el campamento, Jim empieza a comportarse de forma extraña, tiene premoniciones y asusta a los niños con una tragedia que se aproxima.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Tras el ataque al campamento, Rick conduce al grupo hacia el CDC, un recinto de la base sanitaria militar, en el que esperan encontrar un refugio seguro. Durante el trayecto, Jim debe tomar una decisión extremadamente difícil.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Un científico inquietante deja entrar a Rick y su grupo en el CDC. No obstante, hay algo extraño y los supervivientes del apocalipsis zombi empiezan a sospechar que no todo es lo que parece en el recinto.

programme.title: La Viuda Joven
programme.desc: Ocurre un asesinato más en la mansión Humboldt. Esta vez la víctima es Vanesa. Justo en el momento de la boda de Inmaculada y Salvatore, se oyen los gritos de su hija, Julie, al ver el cuerpo muerto flotando en la piscina. Todos los invitados a la fiesta fueron interrogados. Algunas personas fueron llevadas hasta la Unidad de Homicidios, como por ejemplo Pedro y Sonia, los empleados de la Baronesa, y Ernesto y Laura, una pareja que aún se desconoce por quien fue invitada. Es allí en la Unidad de Homicidios donde se produce una toma de rehenes por parte de Ernesto. Este señor asegura haber visto el momento del crimen, saber quién es la viuda joven y declara que hace ya tiempo que viene recibiendo amenazas por parte del asesino.

programme.title: Salvador de Mujeres
programme.sub-title: Episodio 36: La noche frustrada de Socorro
programme.desc: Socorro y Salvador no entienden la presencia de Darío. Él les dice que fue contratado por Josefina para ser el guardaespaldas personal de Socorro. Salvador decide irse. Socorro llama a su madre para reclamarle y echa a Darío del lugar para quedarse con Salvador. Socorro le pide a Salvador que se quede en su habitación pues está decidida a pasar la noche con él, pero Felipe lo daña todo llegando en la mitad de la noche. Josefina le confiesa a Julio César que está enamorada de otro hombre. Él se queda triste, pero no se siente capaz de reclamarle. Entonces busca a Isabel para estar junto a ella. Le cuenta que tuvo otro hijo por fuera del matrimonio, pero no le dice que es Ramiro.

programme.title: Engañada
programme.sub-title: Enganada - Episodio 36: Ricardo y Gabriel Unidos por Jesus
programme.desc: Cuando Arelys presiona a Marisela para que le diga si realmente como ella sospecha Gabriel es el padre de su hijo ella lo niega y promete disculparse con Gabriel por la forma en que lo trató. Gabriel reza y pide a Dios para que le ayude a que Jesús tenga una enfermedad más llevadera, sin saber que a sus espaldas Ricardo hace lo mismo y demuestra de alguna forma con gestos el lazo que los une, cosa que también nota Napoleón cuando viene a buscar a Ricardo. El Gavilán sigue haciendo monerías para que Abril deje de llorar y se enfrenta a los demás conductores cuando intentan que se quite de la vía y Abril de alguna forma también trata de protegerlo.

programme.title: Voltea pa' que te enamores
programme.sub-title: Episodio 79: El plan de Theo no fallo
programme.desc: Santiago le confiesa a Eglee que la foto se la robo a su hijo Luis Fernando, y no solo eso también le confiesa que el tiene tiempo enamorado de ella y que es l primera mujer que va a su apartamento, cosa que a ella le encanta escuchar pues jamás se lo imagino, pero sin embargo ella que ya es adulta no quiso engañar al muchacho, le hablo claro, si ellos vana a tener una historia, como en efecto la tendrán, no será motivado a que Rómulo se haya casado con otra, ni a los vinos, ni al despecho ni a nada que se le parezca, será una historia de ellos nada mas, como tiene que ser, sin otro motivo que no sean ellos como protagonistas, sin recuerdos de mas nadie, pues se lo merecen, el acepta esta de acuerdo en todo lo planteado por Eglee. Llego el momento de tirar el ramo, todas las solteras se ponen detrás de la novia, justo en el momento en que Betzaida lo va a lanzar se aparece María Gracia que aún no se había colocado, las catiritas arden de la rabia, pues con ese tamaño que se manda el mujeron ese, ellas quedan en desventaja y efectivamente ella fue quien salio victoriosa, pero como son mujeres las otras dos le arrancaron el ramo y se lo destrozaron apenas le dejaron una flor, bueno una flor para cada una, algo es algo. Rómulo tiene una cara de funeral impresionante, tanto así que su hijo y su ex suegro se le acercan y le piden que por favor cambie esa cara y asuma que ahora tiene otra vida, al pobre no le queda mas remedio, que aceptar que ahora es el marido de otra mujer que no es Eglee, a la que no se puede sacar de la mente en toda la noche. Luego el abuelo de Luis Fernando lo aconseja de que no pierda mas el tiempo, que se fije en esas muchachas tan bonitas que están todo el tiempo detrás de el, Luis Fernando le dice que el sabe mejor que nadie cual es la mujer de su vida, y el abuelo que no entiende como un muchacho puede desperdiciar a tanta mujer bonita y joven juntas, le aconseja que entonces busque a Dileidi o a María o a como se llame y le diga lo que le tenga que decir de una buena vez, que se despida de ella. La Nena llega a su casa en un estado de rabia impresionante, tiene mezclado la rabia y la pena al mismo tiempo, y todo por andar con Theo quien fue el payaso de la noche, no deja de recordar la cara de todos riéndose de ella y de Theo por supuesto, lo descarga totalmente, le dice de nuevo lo que siempre le dice que el no esta a su altura, que la diferencia entre ellos es abismal, bueno le suelta cuanta cosa se le ocurre, el escucha y trata de calmarla, hasta que ella lo corre otra vez, que no lo quiere ver mas nunca en su vida, en fin lo mismo de siempre, pero el Theo que no es bobo, la agarra y la besa y ella que no aguanta dos, al principio forcejea un poco, pero que va ese Theo se las sabe todas, sabía que su plan no fallaría, que la Nena esta enamorado de ella y pasa la noche de nuevo con ella, al día siguiente ella esta reprochándose el haber sido débil y se jura a si misma que será la última vez, como siempre, el sin embargo esta clarito y feliz, sabe que esa mujer lo quiere aunque como ella dice pertenezcan a clases sociales distintas, en el amor eso como que no cuenta mucho o por lo menos en este caso. Dileidi le pregunta a su mamá si es verdad que un clavo saca otro clavo, ella le responde que no, que eso es mentira, que sea inteligente y no le de toda su felicidad a una sola persona. Ya están en el hotel Betzadia y Rómulo, ella esta ansiosa el esta preocupado por que la nevera no abre, no encuentra el control remoto del televisor, se queja de que para el precio que les están cobrando el servicio es pésimo, ella con toda su calma le hace ver las cosas, es su primera noche de casados y el no lo esta haciendo nada bien, cuando por fin el entiende, le pide disculpas y se comporta como tiene que ser. Luis Fernando quería cerrar la noche con broche de oro con la miss, pero su mamá le echo a perder el plan, la muchacha aprovecha y se escapa, esta todo extrañado pues pensaba que iba a conseguir a su mamá muriéndose en llanto y no paso todo lo contrario, le pregunta a su mamá que de donde viene y que si tomo, ella solo se ríe, todo lo demás es obvio, solo que no le dice a su hijo nada. Al día siguiente Luis Fernando lo primero que hace es ir a donde trabaja Dileidi, le pide que hablen, ella acepta, el le dice que se presenten y ella acepta de nuevo, le echa toda su verdadera historia, quien es en realidad, donde vive y de quien es hija, que trabaja y estudia al mismo tiempo, en pocas palabras que es un tronco de mujer y que ahora no le da pena, que en realidad no le ha dado pena nunca, el le reprocha que por que no le dijo eso desde el principio, y ella le echa en cara que en que momento, cuando se reía de saber que había gente con el nombre de Dileidi, o cuando decía que el con pobres que vivieran en barrios nada que ver o cuando le dijo que el con las cachifas no iba ni a la esquina, se queda loco, no sabe que decir, de paso le echa en cara que es mentiroso, pues varias veces lo vío con las catiritas pasando enfrente de ella, solo que el no sabía que ella estaba ahí, total que el tipo quedo casi mudo, y para rematarlo le pregunto que si ella hubiese sido honesta desde la primera vez el no se hubiera ido corriendo al saber que ella viene de una condición muy humilde, muy inferior a la de el.

programme.title: Episodio 24: Luis y la aparici n de Emperatriz
programme.desc: Luis habla con In s acerca de su decisi n de irse de la casa y se da cuenta que no puede hacerlo por su familia. Marisela llega llorando al jard n para hablar con Che to, pero ste no la entiende y sale corriendo. D bora invita a Luis a la fiesta de Walter. Berta pregunta por Emperatriz y Campuzano le dice que la vio con Marisela en la avenida. In s y Asunta se sorprenden de ver a Emperatriz en la casa de los Nu ez. Emperatriz empieza hablar cosas sin sentido e In s le ofrece un te. Flavia se presenta en la oficina de Armando y se lo lleva a comer a un restaurante rom ntico. Armando trata de justificar una llamada de Solbella diciendo que es por el negocio.

programme.title: Mundo de Fieras
programme.desc: Rosario Flores, conocida por todos como "Charito", es una muchacha buena y hermosa que vive sola en el campo con su madre, María Antonieta. El padre de Charito, Leoncio Palacios, las abandonó a las dos mucho tiempo atrás para irse con su nueva esposa, Miriam. La salud de María Antonieta empeora, por lo que le pide a Leoncio, que también tiene una hija llamada Joselyn, que cuide de Charito. Joselyn Palacios, que sufre problemas mentales, en realidad no es hija de Leoncio, sino de una relación extraconyugal de Miriam con otro hombre, Federico Ansola. María Antonieta fallece después de un tiempo y su hija queda totalmente sola. Por suerte para ella, Chabela Soriano, una vieja amiga de su madre, la hospeda en su casa junto a sus dos hijos.

Es allí en la Unidad de Homicidios donde se produce una toma de rehenes por parte de Ernesto. Este señor asegura haber visto el momento del crimen, saber quién es la viuda joven y declara que hace ya tiempo que viene recibiendo amenazas por parte del asesino.

programme.title: Salvador de Mujeres
programme.sub-title: Episodio 36: La noche frustrada de Socorro
programme.desc: Socorro y Salvador no entienden la presencia de Darío. Él les dice que fue contratado por Josefina para ser el guardaespaldas personal de Socorro. Salvador decide irse. Socorro llama a su madre para reclamarle y echa a Darío del lugar para quedarse con Salvador. Socorro le pide a Salvador que se quede en su habitación pues está decidida a pasar la noche con él, pero Felipe lo daña todo llegando en la mitad de la noche. Josefina le confiesa a Julio César que está enamorada de otro hombre. Él se queda triste, pero no se siente capaz de reclamarle. Entonces busca a Isabel para estar junto a ella. Le cuenta que tuvo otro hijo por fuera del matrimonio, pero no le dice que es Ramiro.

programme.title: Engañada
programme.sub-title: Enganada - Episodio 36: Ricardo y Gabriel Unidos por Jesus
programme.desc: Cuando Arelys presiona a Marisela para que le diga si realmente como ella sospecha Gabriel es el padre de su hijo ella lo niega y promete disculparse con Gabriel por la forma en que lo trató. Gabriel reza y pide a Dios para que le ayude a que Jesús tenga una enfermedad más llevadera, sin saber que a sus espaldas Ricardo hace lo mismo y demuestra de alguna forma con gestos el lazo que los une, cosa que también nota Napoleón cuando viene a buscar a Ricardo. El Gavilán sigue haciendo monerías para que Abril deje de llorar y se enfrenta a los demás conductores cuando intentan que se quite de la vía y Abril de alguna forma también trata de protegerlo.

programme.title: Voltea pa' que te enamores
programme.sub-title: Episodio 79: El plan de Theo no fallo
programme.desc: Santiago le confiesa a Eglee que la foto se la robo a su hijo Luis Fernando, y no solo eso también le confiesa que el tiene tiempo enamorado de ella y que es l primera mujer que va a su apartamento, cosa que a ella le encanta escuchar pues jamás se lo imagino, pero sin embargo ella que ya es adulta no quiso engañar al muchacho, le hablo claro, si ellos vana a tener una historia, como en efecto la tendrán, no será motivado a que Rómulo se haya casado con otra, ni a los vinos, ni al despecho ni a nada que se le parezca, será una historia de ellos nada mas, como tiene que ser, sin otro motivo que no sean ellos como protagonistas, sin recuerdos de mas nadie, pues se lo merecen, el acepta esta de acuerdo en todo lo planteado por Eglee. Llego el momento de tirar el ramo, todas las solteras se ponen detrás de la novia, justo en el momento en que Betzaida lo va a lanzar se aparece María Gracia que aún no se había colocado, las catiritas arden de la rabia, pues con ese tamaño que se manda el mujeron ese, ellas quedan en desventaja y efectivamente ella fue quien salio victoriosa, pero como son mujeres las otras dos le arrancaron el ramo y se lo destrozaron apenas le dejaron una flor, bueno una flor para cada una, algo es algo. Rómulo tiene una cara de funeral impresionante, tanto así que su hijo y su ex suegro se le acercan y le piden que por favor cambie esa cara y asuma que ahora tiene otra vida, al pobre no le queda mas remedio, que aceptar que ahora es el marido de otra mujer que no es Eglee, a la que no se puede sacar de la mente en toda la noche. Luego el abuelo de Luis Fernando lo aconseja de que no pierda mas el tiempo, que se fije en esas muchachas tan bonitas que están todo el tiempo detrás de el, Luis Fernando le dice que el sabe mejor que nadie cual es la mujer de su vida, y el abuelo que no entiende como un muchacho puede desperdiciar a tanta mujer bonita y joven juntas, le aconseja que entonces busque a Dileidi o a María o a como se llame y le diga lo que le tenga que decir de una buena vez, que se despida de ella. La Nena llega a su casa en un estado de rabia impresionante, tiene mezclado la rabia y la pena al mismo tiempo, y todo por andar con Theo quien fue el payaso de la noche, no deja de recordar la cara de todos riéndose de ella y de Theo por supuesto, lo descarga totalmente, le dice de nuevo lo que siempre le dice que el no esta a su altura, que la diferencia entre ellos es abismal, bueno le suelta cuanta cosa se le ocurre, el escucha y trata de calmarla, hasta que ella lo corre otra vez, que no lo quiere ver mas nunca en su vida, en fin lo mismo de siempre, pero el Theo que no es bobo, la agarra y la besa y ella que no aguanta dos, al principio forcejea un poco, pero que va ese Theo se las sabe todas, sabía que su plan no fallaría, que la Nena esta enamorado de ella y pasa la noche de nuevo con ella, al día siguiente ella esta reprochándose el haber sido débil y se jura a si misma que será la última vez, como siempre, el sin embargo esta clarito y feliz, sabe que esa mujer lo quiere aunque como ella dice pertenezcan a clases sociales distintas, en el amor eso como que no cuenta mucho o por lo menos en este caso. Dileidi le pregunta a su mamá si es verdad que un clavo saca otro clavo, ella le responde que no, que eso es mentira, que sea inteligente y no le de toda su felicidad a una sola persona. Ya están en el hotel Betzadia y Rómulo, ella esta ansiosa el esta preocupado por que la nevera no abre, no encuentra el control remoto del televisor, se queja de que para el precio que les están cobrando el servicio es pésimo, ella con toda su calma le hace ver las cosas, es su primera noche de casados y el no lo esta haciendo nada bien, cuando por fin el entiende, le pide disculpas y se comporta como tiene que ser. Luis Fernando quería cerrar la noche con broche de oro con la miss, pero su mamá le echo a perder el plan, la muchacha aprovecha y se escapa, esta todo extrañado pues pensaba que iba a conseguir a su mamá muriéndose en llanto y no paso todo lo contrario, le pregunta a su mamá que de donde viene y que si tomo, ella solo se ríe, todo lo demás es obvio, solo que no le dice a su hijo nada. Al día siguiente Luis Fernando lo primero que hace es ir a donde trabaja Dileidi, le pide que hablen, ella acepta, el le dice que se presenten y ella acepta de nuevo, le echa toda su verdadera historia, quien es en realidad, donde vive y de quien es hija, que trabaja y estudia al mismo tiempo, en pocas palabras que es un tronco de mujer y que ahora no le da pena, que en realidad no le ha dado pena nunca, el le reprocha que por que no le dijo eso desde el principio, y ella le echa en cara que en que momento, cuando se reía de saber que había gente con el nombre de Dileidi, o cuando decía que el con pobres que vivieran en barrios nada que ver o cuando le dijo que el con las cachifas no iba ni a la esquina, se queda loco, no sabe que decir, de paso le echa en cara que es mentiroso, pues varias veces lo vío con las catiritas pasando enfrente de ella, solo que el no sabía que ella estaba ahí, total que el tipo quedo casi mudo, y para rematarlo le pregunto que si ella hubiese sido honesta desde la primera vez el no se hubiera ido corriendo al saber que ella viene de una condición muy humilde, muy inferior a la de el.

programme.title: Episodio 24: Luis y la aparici n de Emperatriz
programme.desc: Luis habla con In s acerca de su decisi n de irse de la casa y se da cuenta que no puede hacerlo por su familia. programme.title: Mundo de Fieras
programme.desc: Rosario Flores, conocida por todos como "Charito", es una muchacha buena y hermosa que vive sola en el campo con su madre, María Antonieta. programme.title: La Viuda Joven
programme.desc: Abril y Vicenta creen que sus hijos se encuentran cambiados, es por eso que deciden realizarles una prueba de ADN con sus padres. Vicenta se pone nerviosa porque ese hijo no es de Federico, por lo que el ADN nunca dará positivo. Tania, trabajadora de la UDH es asesinada a manos de Ernesto, quien también hiere a Josué. Alejandro logró engañarlo y pegarle un tiro para detenerlo. Josué queda internado y la Pelusa va hacia el hospital, donde tiene una discusión con Ivana, ya que ésta última quiere exclusividad con su hijo. Se lleva a cabo el funeral de Vanesa, en donde Julie le lee unas palabras, expresando su arrepiento y dolor. En este lugar, Julio amanzana a Christian, ya que cree que él es la viuda negra. Sin embargo, Christian niega todo.

programme.sub-title: Taste the Music: The Aromatic Cuisine of the Asia Minor Greeks
